access.notes: Open‑source atomistic simulation code supporting empirical potentials, shell model, Ewald summation, and conjugate‑gradient minimisation. Version 5.0 or later recommended.

resources.name: Empirical pair potential parameters for α-Al₂O₃ (Catlow et al.)

access.notes: Short‑range O–Al and O–O parameters (A, ρ, C), shell charges and spring constants. All values are tabulated in the task instruction.

resources.name: Empirical pair potential parameters for M₂O₃ dopants (Bush et al.)

access.notes: Short‑range M–O parameters (A, ρ, C) and shell parameters for Fe₂O₃, Yb₂O₃, Eu₂O₃, La₂O₃. All values are tabulated in the task instruction.
Shannon radii for 6‑coordinate M³⁺: Al³⁺=0.535 Å, Fe³⁺=0.645 Å, Yb³⁺=0.868 Å, Eu³⁺=0.947 Å, La³⁺=1.032 Å. Used to compute Δr for trend analysis; a small table is included in the instruction.
Standard corundum structure: space group R-3c, lattice parameters a=4.76 Å, c=12.99 Å (or from Catlow et al.). The agent may use any published crystallographic data.
